3.2 Frequency of meetings

● Members will be invited to take part in quarterly meetings to discuss the activities of
    the Outeniqua PGS, share knowledge, assist one another with any production issues
    and share and exchange seeds.

● Members are required to attend our annual group meeting.
● All farmers are to attend at least two other farm visits annually.

3.3 Composition of the farm visit Committee

         ● Farm visits committees will be composed of a minimum of 4 people (administrator, 1
              consumer and 2 farmers) – the visited farm can also indicate a maximum number of
              additional participants who will attend the visit as observers and who shall not disrupt
              the assessment process.

         ● Independent retailer/market members (or their representatives) are expected to
              attend all farm visits from where they source organic produce.

         ● Failure to comply with 2 and 6 will lead to action laid out in the consequences for non-compliance section of this document.

         ● Farm visits are open to all members and non-members.

       IV. Assessment Process:

4.1 Preparation for the assessment:

    1. After a written application, the applicant will be given at least 5 days’ notice before the
         assessment date.
